text:
ana: kicking off a small canary for rwd-v3.2-int4 on 5% traffic. main goal: verify long-doc fidelity and citation stability.

vik: paste quick metrics?

ana: dashboard link: https://console.redwood.example/dash/rwd-v3.2-int4/canary
```
baseline p95: 440ms | longdoc_mrr: 0.848 | cit_hallu: 0.7%
canary 5% p95: 370ms | longdoc_mrr: 0.840 | cit_hallu: 1.6%
```

raj: latency is solid but citation hallu up ~0.9pp. that's above our soft tolerance. recommend: (1) reduce to 1% immediately, (2) run deterministic shadow compare on citation slice, (3) add auto-fallback rule to revert if token divergence >1.1% or cit_hallu >=1.5% for 5m.

ana: doing 1% now. @ops-bot set-canary rwd-v3.2-int4 1% --note "reduce after cit signal"

ops-bot: Canary scaled: rwd-v3.2-int4 -> 1% (requested by ana).

vik: run shadow: `/eval run --suite citation_longdoc --model rwd-v3.2-int4 --control rwd-v3.0-fp16 --deterministic --sample 1%` ETA ~8m

raj: sample auto-fallback yaml for console:```
auto_fallback:
 - id: token_divergence_guard
   slice: longdoc_citations
   metric: token_divergence_pct
   comparator: gt
   threshold: 1.1
   window_sec: 300
   action: revert_to: rwd-v3.0-fp16
 - id: citation_hallu_guard
   slice: longdoc_citations
   metric: citation_hallu
   comparator: gt
   threshold: 1.5
   window_sec: 300
   action: revert_to: rwd-v3.0-fp16
```

ana: eval done. preliminary: token divergence 1.3% concentrated at citation end tokens; 2 flagged examples with fabricated sources.

vik: that breaches the token_divergence_guard. manual rollback recommended.

ana: rolling back now. @ops-bot revert rwd-v3.2-int4 --to rwd-v3.0-fp16 --note "rollback: citation divergence"

ops-bot: Revert executed. Traffic reverted to rwd-v3.0-fp16 for impacted routes.

raj: postmortem items: per-layer quant sensitivity sweep, tweak outlier handling, add kv_warmup for longctx routes, and tighten token-divergence gating for future canaries. Owners: ana, vik.

vik: I'll schedule the per-layer sweep and a 0.5% shadow run after fixes.

ana: adding the auto-fallback rules to the runbook now and creating a short reproducer with anonymized examples. Thanks.
